title: 第5章 垂星瀑布第6章 潭底溶洞
slug: 你是来修仙还是来观光的
lines: 飞流直下三千尺，疑是银河落九天。
李白的诗运用了夸张的修辞手法。
放在垂星瀑布上，却十分的贴切。
水流从空中落下，高度怕是不止三千尺。
这些水还没落下，就有半数在空中化作水雾飞散。
整个瀑布，被浓厚的水汽包裹，站在瀑布的底下，是看不瀑布的顶端的。
若碰到天气好，有日光，瀑布下会有经久不散的双重彩虹，着实美轮美奂。
郑常躺在瀑布底的水潭边上，双脚没入水中，感受着冰凉的湖水，十分惬意。
看着周围弥漫的水汽和清晰的彩虹，郑常仿佛置身于云端，倚虹而坐的仙人。
可惜景是真仙景，人是假仙人。只有炼气一层的郑常，也就比凡人强上一点。
“系统，你在吗？”
【在的，宿主有什么事吗？】
“你有没有能拍照留影的功能啊？”
【本系统的功能是协助宿主完成任务成就大道，并没有这种多余的功能。】
“可惜了，这么美的景色，我还想着记录下来，等你获得了足够的权限能够看到这个世界得时候再拿给你分享呢。”
系统愕然，一时间不知道说什么好了。
“不过没有也没关系，等到时我们再回来重新走一遍也不是不可以。”
【谢谢你，宿主。】
“客气什么，一个人观光挺无聊的，有你这样不用吃喝，没有意见，我去哪跟到哪的旅游搭子实在是太完美。”
郑常俯身到水潭，捧起一捧潭水。
潭水入手冰凉，就像是手捧一块冰块一样。
此时虽然是秋天，但仍有几分暑气未消，冰凉的潭水正好散去残留的暑气。
若是再晚半个月来，这潭水就有些寒凉了。
郑常捧着手里的潭水，想了想，决定选择性无视刚刚曾把双脚伸进水潭里的行为，将手中潭水送入了嘴边。
反正系统也看不见，唯一能看见自己黑历史只有自己的宠物玉蜂。
冰凉的潭水沿着食道流入胃里，郑常只觉得浑身舒坦。
农夫山泉有点甜不一定是真的。
但这水潭里的水是真的有一丝甜味。
等会，怎么好像还有一丝铁锈的味道？
哦，原来是是自己牙龈出血了……
content_en:
The flying stream plummeted down three thousand feet, and it was suspected that the Milky Way had fallen into the sky.
Li Bai's poems use exaggerated rhetorical techniques.
It is very appropriate to place it on the Chuixing Waterfall.
The water falls from the sky, and the height is probably more than three thousand feet.
Before the water fell, half of it turned into mist and scattered in the air.
The entire waterfall is wrapped in thick water vapor. Standing at the bottom of the waterfall, you cannot see the top of the waterfall.
If the weather is good and there is sunshine, there will be a long-lasting double rainbow under the waterfall, which is really beautiful.
Zheng Chang lay on the edge of the pool at the bottom of the waterfall, with his feet submerged in the water, feeling the cold lake water, very comfortable.
Looking at the diffuse water vapor and the clear rainbow around him, Zheng Chang felt like he was in the clouds, sitting against the rainbow.
It's a pity that the scenery is a real fairy scene, and the people are fake immortals. Zheng Chang, who is only at the first level of Qi Refining, is only a little stronger than ordinary people.
"System, are you here?"
[Yes, what’s wrong with the host? 】
"Do you have a function that allows you to take photos?"
[The function of this system is to assist the host in completing tasks and achieving great things. It does not have such redundant functions. 】
"It's a pity. I still want to record such a beautiful scenery and share it with you when you get enough permission to see the world."
The system was stunned and didn't know what to say for a moment.
"But it doesn't matter if it doesn't happen. It's not impossible for us to come back and walk it all over again when the time comes."
[Thank you, host. 】
"You're welcome, it's quite boring to go sightseeing alone. You don't have to eat or drink, so I don't have any objections. It's really a perfect travel package for me to follow you wherever I go."
【……】
Zheng Chang leaned over to the pool and picked up a handful of water.
The water in the pool is as cold as holding an ice cube in your hand.
Although it is autumn at this time, there is still a bit of heat that has not subsided, and the cold pool water just dissipates the remaining heat.
If we had come half a month later, the water would have been a little cold.
Zheng Chang held the pool of water in his hand, thought about it, and decided to selectively ignore the act of putting his feet into the pool just now, and put the water in his hand to his mouth.
The system can't see it anyway, the only one who can see his dark history is his pet Jade Bee.
The cold pool water flowed into his stomach along his esophagus, and Zheng Chang felt comfortable all over.
It’s not necessarily true that Nongfu Spring is a bit sweet.
But the water in the pool really has a sweet taste.
Wait, why does it still smell like rust?
Oh, it turns out it was my gums that were bleeding...
